fn main() R<()> {
path := env::args().nth(1).ok_or("usage: csvavg <file>")?
text := fs::read_to_string(&path)?
mut sum := 0.0
mut count := 0.0
for line in text.lines().skip(1) {
field := line.split(',').nth(1).ok_or("missing second column")?
value := field.trim().parse()?
sum += value
count += 1.0
}
println!("{:.2}", sum / count)
Ok(())
}

mut bc := b.chars().collect()

bc.sort()
